declarations.name: AuiAvatarGroup

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the group, such as 'Project members'.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Avatars shown before the '+N' chip (1 to 50).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the overflow count and label.

accessibility.pattern: Named group of images: role=group with aria-label; each avatar is role=img named by its person; the overflow chip is role=img named 'N more'.

limitations: The people behind '+N' are not listed; show the full list elsewhere (for example in a dialog) when it matters.
